name: editor-state-mcp
description: Continuously mirrors your live editor state — active file, selection, cursor, open tabs — into a gitignored JSON file that AI coding agents can always read.

editorStateMcp.enabled.description: Mirror editor state to a file. On by default: this writes one local file and opens no network port. Turning it off removes any existing state and heartbeat file.

editorStateMcp.path.description: Where to write the state file. Relative paths resolve against the first workspace folder; an absolute path is used verbatim.

editorStateMcp.debounceMs.description: Coalescing window for editor events. Selection changes fire on every arrow key, so writes are batched rather than emitted per event.

editorStateMcp.includeSelectionText.description: Include the selected text itself, not just its line range. Turning this off still records the range, and a reader can always open the file directly.

editorStateMcp.maxSelectionBytes.description: Clip selected text longer than this many bytes. The line range is never dropped.

editorStateMcp.excludeGlobs.description: Files whose contents are never copied into the state file. The path and selected range are still recorded; only the text is omitted.

editorStateMcp.maxOpenTabs.description: Cap on the number of open tabs recorded. The active tab is always kept.

editorStateMcp.maxRecentFiles.description: Cap on the most-recently-used file list.

editorStateMcp.autoGitignore.description: Offer once, per workspace, to add the state directory to .gitignore. An existing .gitignore is never edited without asking, and one is never created.

editorStateMcp.heartbeatSeconds.description: How often to touch a liveness file, so a reader can tell 'the user is idle' from 'VS Code died'. Written outside the workspace to avoid tripping project file watchers. 0 disables it.

editorStateMcp.globalMirror.description: Also mirror state to ~/.editor-state-mcp/. Not yet implemented.
